description: This file defines the API function prototypes and object structures for DHCPv4 Data Model support in the COSA library. It primarily contains declaration of external functions for managing DHCPv4 objects, including clients, options, servers, pools, static addresses, and related sub-objects. The file does not contain implementation code or data structure definitions; it serves as an interface specification for other source files.
external_methods: COSA API functions for DHCPv4 configuration objects (e.g., DHCPv4_GetParamBoolValue, Client_GetEntryCount, etc.)
